Freelance Scope & Onboarding Kit

A scope creep and client onboarding workflow for freelancers: find hidden work before you quote, agree scope in writing, and answer extra requests calmly.

Buy — $29

Checkout, payment and any sales tax are handled by Polar, our merchant of record. Taxes are calculated at checkout.

What it does

  • A 5-stage workflow, not a prompt dump. Intake, then hidden-dependency audit, then scope summary, then kickoff, then change requests. Each stage has a template, a prompt and a check step.
  • Find the hidden work early. A 10-category audit (content, access, approvers, third parties, licences, timing and more) with a prompt that flags what the brief doesn't say and asks you to check with the client instead of guessing.
  • A one-page scope summary your client can confirm. Deliverables, "done when", client responsibilities, assumptions, exclusions, revision rounds and a simple change process, written in plain language. Use it alongside your own contract.
  • Ready replies for scope creep. 10 email scripts, a change-request form and a change log built around 3 lanes: Fold in, Quote it or Park it.
  • Works with the tools you have. PDF guide plus editable .docx/.md templates and CSV checklists for Google Sheets or Notion. The prompts work in any chat AI assistant. Includes a full fictional worked example.

What's included

5 PDFs (start-here, guide, prompt pack, worked example, printable checklist), 6 templates in .docx and .md, 2 CSV trackers and a plain-text prompt file. Delivered as one ZIP download.

Important: This kit is not legal advice and the templates are not a contract. The scope summary is designed to sit next to a contract, not replace one. For contract terms, use a contract reviewed by a qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction.

FAQ

Who is this for?
Solo freelancers and small studios selling project work: designers, writers, developers and small agencies. It suits you less if you only bill hourly with no defined deliverables.
Does it guarantee I'll stop scope creep?
No. It gives you a process and wording to spot extra work early and handle it consistently. Results depend on your clients and how you use it.
Is this a contract template?
No. It contains no legal terms. Keep using your contract, ideally one a lawyer has reviewed, and reference it in the scope summary.
Which AI tool do I need?
Any chat assistant that accepts pasted text. The prompts are plain text. You can also use the templates without AI.
Is it safe to paste client briefs into AI?
That depends on your contract, NDA and AI tool settings. The kit includes a short note on what to check and remove first.
What formats do I get?
PDF, .docx (Word/Google Docs/Pages), .md and .csv (Google Sheets/Notion import). There is no Notion template link in this version.
Was this made with AI?
Yes. The kit was written with AI assistance and checked against a written quality checklist before release. The worked example is fictional.
Refunds?
You can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase, no reason needed. See our refund policy for details.
Updates?
This is version 1.1. If we release an updated version, existing buyers get it through the same download link.
